description: This file implements SOAP web service functions for SuiteCRM portal user authentication, session management, and data retrieval, including login, logout, session validation, and CRUD operations for various modules and notes.

classes.name: NoteSoap
classes.description: Helper class for handling note file attachments, including saving and retrieving files.

methods.name: portal_login
methods.description: Authenticates a portal user and starts a session, returning session ID and errors.

methods.name: portal_validate_authenticated
methods.description: Validates a session ID and resumes the session if valid.

methods.name: portal_logout
methods.description: Ends a session for a given session ID.

methods.name: portal_get_sugar_id
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's SugarCRM ID for an authenticated session.

methods.name: portal_get_sugar_contact_id
methods.description: Retrieves the current contact's ID for an authenticated session.

methods.name: portal_get_entry_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries for a module.

methods.name: portal_get_entry_list_filter
methods.description: Retrieves filtered list of entries based on provided criteria.

methods.name: portal_get_entry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific entry by ID from a module.

methods.name: portal_set_entry
methods.description: Creates or updates an entry in a module.

methods.name: portal_set_note_attachment
methods.description: Uploads a note attachment for a note.

methods.name: portal_relate_note_to_module
methods.description: Associates a note with a module record.

methods.name: portal_get_related_notes
methods.description: Retrieves notes related to a module record.

methods.name: portal_get_related_list
methods.description: Retrieves related records for a module.

methods.name: portal_get_subscription_lists
methods.description: Gets newsletter subscription lists for the user.
